description: We are Team Pepers: Luciano, Naim, Cristian, Francisco, Sebastián and Diego, six friends from different parts of Argentina who met at a university residence. In Argentina, choosing what to plant under droughts, floods and shifting prices is a constant challenge, so we chose Field Shift. Each of us took the part we enjoyed or understood best, from data and machine learning to design and storytelling, and we built it the way we do everything: together.
